title: No Creeper Explosions
description: Stops creepers from damaging blocks with their explosions.
body:
• No Creeper Explosions changes how creeper explosions affect the world.

  When a creeper explodes, the explosion no longer breaks blocks. This helps protect terrain, builds, farms, and bases from random creeper damage while still keeping creepers dangerous to players.

  The mod is useful for survival worlds and servers where you want to keep the threat of creepers, but do not want to constantly repair holes, broken paths, damaged houses, or destroyed redstone builds after
  every explosion.
